items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: I don't remember them people. I heard of them, yeah.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear any of the singers from away from here that came in the theaters like Ma Rainey, or say Mamie Smith, or different ones that might have come through here singing at a theater, or on a show, or anything?
I don't remember them people. I heard of them, yeah. As many I went and seen, I couldn't call a name. I wasn't seen at different theaters.
By the way, did you ever travel around in any kind of a show, or carnival, or go away from here to play at all in music?
